about: Live-model evaluation runs (agent tool-selection cases T1–T8 and agentic scenarios S1–S4), one entry per run. Written by the evals when a real model runs; skipped or not-selected cases are left out; scripted runs are never recorded. Seeded from evals/results/latest.json and docs/evidence/agent-traces/SUMMARY.json of the 4 Nov run.
